memes.additionalAction.label: Additional Action
memes.additionalAction.help: Check this if you’re promising an event, donation, physical item, airdrop, or another deliverable alongside the artwork.
memes.additionalAction.planHelp: Describe what you’ll do if selected, who receives it, when it will happen, and any costs or conditions. This plan will be public with your submission.
memes.additionalAction.noPlan: Additional Action marked. No separate plan provided.
memes.additionalAction.loadError: The artist’s plan could not be loaded.
memes.submission.resubmit.loadError: The saved submission could not be loaded. Retry before editing to preserve its fields.
memes.additionalAction.declaration: This is the artist’s commitment. It does not confirm approval or delivery.
memes.additionalAction.tooLong: Shorten your plan to {limit} characters or fewer.
